# tree that still held stale files, with Python 2.7 and classic zlib. build.py reads this

# drops both files and builds with its own reproducible metadata.

#   pestamp <hex>                     the launch4j link time in the exe header

#   time <entry> <date>               zip timestamp of an installer entry
#   legend <letter>=<date> ...        the timestamps of version.jar entries...
#   inner <letters>                   ...one letter per entry, in order
